name: skypies
description: Create links to the files your agents produce and open them on your paired skypies devices.

interface.shortDescription: Your agents’ files, ready to open on your phone.
interface.longDescription: skypies helps Codex share every document it creates with your paired phone, tablet, or Mac. Links are minted by the skypies Mac app and files travel directly between your devices over an end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer connection.
defaultPrompt: Send this report to my phone
Create a document and give me a skypies link
Share this file with my paired skypies devices
